name: Coursera
best_for: University-taught fundamentals (structural theory, hydrology, GIS), some official certificates
pricing: Free to audit most content; Certificates ~49–79 USD/course or Coursera Plus subscription ~59 USD/month
notes: Good for theory; not for software-specific hands-on skills

name: Udemy
best_for: Software tutorials: AutoCAD, ETABS, SAP2000, Revit, Primavera, Excel
pricing: Per-course, usually 10–20 USD on sale (listed price often 80–150 USD)
notes: Frequent sales make it very cheap; quality varies by instructor — check reviews

name: edX
best_for: University-level engineering courses (MIT, Delft, Berkeley, etc.)
pricing: Free to audit; verified certificate ~50–300 USD
notes: Strong for rigorous theory (hydrology, transportation, geotechnical)

name: LinkedIn Learning
best_for: Software basics, project management soft skills
pricing: Subscription ~19.99–39.99 USD/month (often bundled free with LinkedIn Premium)
notes: Good breadth but shallower depth than Udemy for CAD/analysis software

name: Autodesk (official)
best_for: AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, Navisworks official certification
pricing: Free official tutorials; Certified User exam ≈120 USD, Certified Professional ≈200 USD
notes: The only source for an official Autodesk-branded certificate

name: PMI (official)
best_for: PMP, PMI-RMP, PMI-ACP certification exams
pricing: PMP exam: 405 USD (member) / 555 USD (non-member); membership ≈139 USD/yr
notes: Training course (35 contact hours) is mandatory and is bought separately from any REP provider

name: USGBC / GBCI (official)
best_for: LEED Green Associate / LEED AP
pricing: Green Associate exam ≈100 USD (student) / 250 USD (professional)
notes: Study materials/prep courses available free-to-paid across many platforms

name: Bentley Institute
best_for: PLAXIS, WaterCAD/WaterGEMS, OpenRoads, HEC-RAS-adjacent tools
pricing: Many self-paced courses free; instructor-led courses vary, often 100–400 USD
notes: Good free library for Bentley-owned geotechnical/water software

name: Esri Academy
best_for: ArcGIS, spatial analysis
pricing: Many free self-paced courses; paid instructor-led courses 100–300 USD
notes: Official Esri training; strongest source for ArcGIS specifically

name: USACE HEC (official)
best_for: HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS (hydrology/hydraulics)
pricing: Free — software and official tutorials are both free
notes: Best free resource for water-resources modeling skills

name: freeCodeCamp
best_for: Full free curriculum: web dev, Python, data analysis
pricing: Completely free (donation-supported)
notes: One of the best free starting points for self-taught developers

name: Coursera
best_for: University certificates: CS fundamentals, data science, AI, Google/IBM career certificates
pricing: Free to audit; Certificates ~49–79 USD/course or Coursera Plus ~59 USD/month
notes: Google & IBM career certificates are popular, affordable entry credentials

name: Udemy
best_for: Practical skill courses: specific languages/frameworks (React, Python, Docker, etc.)
pricing: Per-course, usually 10–20 USD on sale (listed 80–150 USD)
notes: Frequent sales make this very cheap; quality varies by instructor

name: edX
best_for: University-level CS courses (MIT, Harvard CS50, etc.)
pricing: Free to audit; verified certificate ~50–300 USD
notes: Harvard's CS50 is a widely respected free intro to CS

name: AWS Skill Builder
best_for: AWS cloud skills and certification prep
pricing: Large free course library; some paid subscription content
notes: Official AWS training source

name: Microsoft Learn
best_for: Azure, Power BI, Microsoft 365, DevOps skills
pricing: Free — all official learning paths are free
notes: Best free resource for Microsoft-stack certifications

name: Cisco Networking Academy
best_for: Networking fundamentals, CCNA prep
pricing: Free to low-cost when accessed through a partner institution
notes: Partner-institution access is much cheaper than commercial CCNA courses

name: EC-Council (official)
best_for: CEH and other cybersecurity certifications
pricing: Exam voucher packages vary (~950–1,199 USD)
notes: Confirm the current package price directly — EC-Council pricing structures change

name: Offensive Security
best_for: OSCP and other hands-on penetration-testing certifications
pricing: Bundled course + exam ≈1,600–2,000 USD
notes: Advanced, highly respected practical credential

name: GitHub Skills / Atlassian University
best_for: Git/GitHub workflow, Jira/Confluence
pricing: Free official training
notes: Good free resources for tools used on almost every dev team
